name: Frigidaire Gallery® 36" Stainless Steel Induction Cooktop
shortDescription: The Frigidaire Gallery 36" Induction Cooktop, features the premium MatteGuard™ Surface that reduces visible scratching by 5X, helping your cooktop maintain a beautiful, like-new finish over time. Experience the speed of induction, with a powerful 3,600-Watt PowerPlus® Burner that boils water 50% faster than gas cooktops. The easy-to-use integrated touch-control panel offers a sleek and seamless design and makes cooking and cleaning easier.

features.text: MatteGuard™ Surface
The new MatteGuard™ surface reduces visible scratching by 5X, helping your cooktop stay looking newer for longer.
Easy-to-Clean Cooktop
Unlike traditional electric and gas cooktops, Induction only heats the pan and the food in it, so the area around the pan stays cooler, allowing you to clean up spills and splatters while you cook.
3,600-Watt PowerPlus® Burner
The 3,600-Watt PowerPlus® Burner combines power and precision - boiling water 50% faster than gas, while offering the precision and responsiveness of induction cooking.
2-in-1 Bridge Element
Allows for simultaneous control of two elements, perfect for a griddle pan or large pot.
Power Boost
Speed up your time to boil with Power Boost - available on all burners.
Integrated Touch-Controls
The integrated touch-control panel offers a sleek and seamless design, and when in use, allows you to adjust the heat with a simple swipe of your finger.
Incredibly Responsive
Induction goes from a powerful boil to a low simmer, almost immediately.
Safer Cooktop Surface
Induction only heats the pan and the food in it, so the area around the pan stays cooler.
More Energy Efficient
Use less energy while you cook with energy-efficient induction technology which heats the pan directly, so it loses less heat during the cooking process.
Compatible with Most Cookware
Most stainless steel and cast-iron cookware compatible with induction elements. Rule of thumb: if a magnet sticks to the bottom of the cookware, it’s induction compatible.
Installation over Wall Oven Approved
Cooktops are approved for installation above any of our Frigidaire or Frigidaire Gallery Single Electric Wall Ovens.
